answer: An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 25 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The ocean counter is kept in vine and quartz shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 25 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1842 identities would post 554 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
